page.notes: Right column at top is a continuation of the left column's notes; the right-hand column is cut short by the scan. Text at the bottom of the left column is cut off. Some marginal references in the left column are set in italics and treated as part of the text. The upper part of the right column and the top of the left column are cut off in this image. Several word ends are doubtful and the Greek words are printed in Latin letters here as the scan gives them; "cubantes", "Ieffæo" and "Oleastro" are uncertain readings.
